instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly apply the 'Unbounded' font for headings and 'Chivo' for body. If not available in standard Google Fonts, add them to index.html or global CSS.
Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 for the Kanban and Bento grids. Use tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) for dashboards.
Hero overlays MUST be bg-black/60 to let the background image shine while maintaining text contrast.
Implement glassmorphic surfaces using 'bg-white/[0.03] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10'.
All interactive elements must have 'data-testid' for testing.
Primary call to action buttons must be Laser Green (#00FFA3) with black text and a glowing box-shadow.
Use Skeleton components from Shadcn to simulate loading states in the 'swipeable cards' and 'Kanban board' areas.
For live countdowns, use Monospace font ('Azeret Mono') with tracking-widest.
Avoid standard Shadcn Vercel look. Override Shadcn border-radius to rounded-2xl for cards and rounded-xl for buttons.
Render the personalized greeting 'Hey [Name], ready to write?' dynamically using Unbounded font at text-4xl.
